metadata.title: Admissions | Sanskriti Kindergarten Chennai
metadata.description: Apply for admissions at Sanskriti Kindergarten Chennai and learn about preschool, play school, kindergarten, and daycare enrollment.

hero.subtitle: Share your child's details and our admissions team will guide you to the right program and next step.

image.alt: Children beginning their learning journey at Sanskriti Kindergarten

process.title: Admissions made calm, clear, and personal.
process.description: A clear, parent-friendly process from first enquiry to the right program fit.

steps.description: Tell us about your child, preferred program, and how to reach you.
